title: Why + eats the left side
prompt: `let joined = base + tag;` compiles, but using `base` afterwards does not. Why?
answer: The `+` operator on `String` takes the left side by value, so `base` moves into the result. Any later use is E0382. Use `base.push_str(tag)` when you want to keep the binding.

example.caption: push_str grows in place instead of consuming.
